children: PowerCompute entered into a new non-recourse, 30-day collared loan facility with Arch Lending to refinance debt and manage Bitcoin price risk. On Aug 25, 2026, the company borrowed $21,892,131.88 secured by 307 Bitcoin, with a 6.5% interest rate and initial collar terms: floor $71,112, ceiling $75,000, and barrier $93,500. The facility auto-rolls every 30 days with terms reset to market. Proceeds repaid an Aug 3, 2026 Arch loan and funded the prior collar feature.
: Non-recourse, 30-day collared loan secured by Bitcoin
: Refinance prior loan and manage Bitcoin price risk
